---
title: "Reading Log"
toc: false
---

::: {.reading-log-intro}

A chronological record of my reading activity, searchable by book and date.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)

source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Import datasets
# --------------------------------------------------

books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    book_id = col_character(),
    date = col_date(),
    page_reached = col_integer()
  )
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Calculate recorded reading progress
# --------------------------------------------------

book_progress <- calculate_book_progress(
  books,
  reading_log
)

logged_entries <- book_progress |>
  left_join(
    books |>
      select(book_id, book_page),
    by = "book_id"
  ) |>
  select(
    date,
    title,
    pages_read,
    page_reached,
    book_page
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Identify dates without reading records
# --------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(book_progress) > 0) {

  empty_days <- tibble(
    date = seq.Date(
      min(book_progress$date),
      max(book_progress$date),
      by = "day"
    )
  ) |>
    anti_join(
      book_progress |> distinct(date),
      by = "date"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      title = "No entry recorded",
      pages_read = NA_integer_,
      page_reached = NA_integer_,
      book_page = NA_character_
    )

} else {

  empty_days <- tibble(
    date = as.Date(character()),
    title = character(),
    pages_read = integer(),
    page_reached = integer(),
    book_page = character()
  )

}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Generate clickable book titles
# --------------------------------------------------

make_log_link <- function(title, page) {

  if (title == "No entry recorded") {

    return(
      as.character(
        tags$span(
          class = "log-unrecorded",
          "No entry recorded"
        )
      )
    )

  }

  if (is.na(page) || !nzchar(page)) {

    return(
      as.character(htmlEscape(title))
    )

  }

  page_url <- str_replace(
    page,
    "\\.qmd$",
    ".html"
  )

  as.character(
    tags$a(
      href = page_url,
      class = "log-book-link",
      title
    )
  )

}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare the display table
# --------------------------------------------------

display_log <- bind_rows(
  logged_entries,
  empty_days
) |>
  arrange(desc(date), title) |>
  mutate(
    book_display = map2_chr(
      title,
      book_page,
      make_log_link
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Date = as.character(date),
    Book = book_display,
    `Pages Read` = pages_read,
    `Page Reached` = page_reached
  )
```

## Reading History

The table records dated reading entries across all books. Dates without entries are shown between the earliest and latest recorded reading dates. A missing entry does not necessarily mean that no reading occurred.

::: {.reading-log-page}

```{r}
#| echo: false

DT::datatable(
  display_log,

  rownames = FALSE,

  # Allow clickable titles in the Book column
  escape = c(1, 3, 4),

  class = "hover",

  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    lengthChange = TRUE,
    lengthMenu = list(
      c(10, 15, 25, 50, 100, -1),
      c("10", "15", "25", "50", "100", "All")
    ),
    searching = TRUE,
    ordering = TRUE,

    # Newest dates first
    order = list(
      list(0, "desc")
    ),

    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,

    language = list(
      search = "Search log:",
      emptyTable = "No reading entries yet."
    )
  )
)
```

:::
